CA.rationale: A (attention/emergence) is not present, so no C+A binding.

COD.rationale: O and D are absent, so no C+O+D binding.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or processing condition linked to the content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Identifies a content ('tile') with an attribute ('red').

D.rationale: No separate distinction of identification versus organization/presentation/status is made.

O.rationale: Provides coordinates/location only; coordinates/position alone do not qualify as organization/presentation under the rules.
